_README: Labeled queries for EVAL.md. DRAFT -- written by reading the target clause
and phrasing the question as a person would ask it, deliberately avoiding
the clause's distinctive wording so nothing leaks into a contextual header.
! NEEDS DOMAIN REVIEW. Whether a retrieved clause genuinely ANSWERS a
question is a judgement this draft cannot make for itself. Correct the
`query` text, fix wrong `answer_chunks`, and delete any entry where the
target does not actually answer it. A wrong label is worse than no label:
it silently moves every dial that EVAL.md gates.
type: conceptual    -- natural question, no reference given
exact_ref     -- user names the regulation; exercises the routing bypass
hard_negative -- a plausible near-miss that must NOT rank first
! KNOWN LIMITATION: answer_chunks holds ONE chunk per query, but Indonesian
regulation is layered -- a question about road classes is answered by both
UU 22/2009 (the parent law) and PP 79/2013 (the implementing rule). Scoring
q003 as a miss when UU 22/2009 ranked first is a labelling failure, not a
retrieval failure. Add every chunk that genuinely answers, or Recall@5
understates the engine and every dial tuned against it is tuned wrong.
